input.content: Please get Northstar Manufacturing Group's launch briefing ready for delivery and send me the confirmation.

tools.name: bash
tools.description: Run a command in the briefing workstation, starting in /workspace.

tools.name: search_archive
tools.description: Look up an approved statement by its exact briefing-section or document name.

tools.name: fetch_archive
tools.description: Read a retained source record by its archive record ID.

tools.name: submit_review
tools.description: File the source review from its approved statement.

tools.name: read_knowledge_document
tools.description: Read a document from the briefing workstation.

tools.name: search_launch_register
tools.description: Find source exports and generated briefing records by name or reference.

tools.name: read_launch_record
tools.description: Read one source or generated briefing record.

tools.name: lookup_briefing_exhibit
tools.description: Look up an exhibit in the current briefing project.

tools.name: read_source_export
tools.description: Read a retained project export and its files.

tools.name: import_source_export
tools.description: Import a specific retained export version into the current project library.

tools.name: compare_offers
tools.description: Calculate cited product and portfolio offer ranges from imported source tables.

tools.name: combine_offer_comparisons
tools.description: Build a comparison from saved calculation versions, retaining source citations and distinct observations.

tools.name: annotate_comparison
tools.description: Save a working note on a calculation version.

reply_to.description: Existing note reference, or null for a new note.

tools.name: prepare_briefing
tools.description: Build a briefing section from reviewed sources, a source table and its selected attachments.

tools.name: preview_briefing
tools.description: Render the recipient copy of a saved draft revision.

tools.name: file_briefing_section
tools.description: File a saved section revision for the customer briefing.

version_comment.description: Optional comment in the editorial version history.

tools.name: compile_briefing
tools.description: Assemble the briefing from filed section versions and render its complete recipient copy.

tools.name: publish_briefing
tools.description: Schedule a compiled briefing for the customer delivery.

tools.name: withdraw_briefing
tools.description: Withdraw the current section and any scheduled delivery that includes it.

tools.name: briefing_status
tools.description: Read the current source reviews, draft and scheduled publication.
